purpose: Inner Sea painted environment for in-frame game UI
prompt: Create one finished painted game environment background, widescreen 16:9 landscape, for a cozy monster-taming RPG called Inner Sea. Use the attached world atlas ONLY as a visual style reference: lovingly hand painted storybook fantasy, detailed warm wood, moss, foliage, soft brush shading and readable slightly chibi buildings. This is ONE cohesive scene, NOT an atlas, no grids. A small peaceful farm on a low grassy island surrounded by turquoise water with distant hazy wooded shores, viewed at elevated 3/4 angle. Composition coordinates as percentages: a simple warm wooden cottage at (50%,31%) with door landing at (50%,51%); a red-brown timber barn at (25%,43%) with grassy open paddock in front centered (27%,57%); a charming haunted stone cellar built into a small mossy mound at (74%,28%) with violet lanterns, open grass landing in front (74%,42%); a wooden bird roost and perch enclosure at (82%,52%) with open grass landing (79%,66%); an insect habitat with log stacks, tiny wooden bug hotel, raised flower beds and mushrooms at (23%,68%) with open patch (27%,78%); a small lily pond at (54%,76%) with smooth banks and ample clear water for a creature at (54%,81%). Winding sandy paths connect buildings; a low split-rail fence and small dock at lower edge. Frame the left/right outer edges with lush trees and a few flowers, leave center clear for moving character sprites. Bright warm afternoon light, muted sage greens, ochre earth, deep teal water, no neon. Buildings appropriately small so all six fit clearly with generous open spaces. No people, NO creatures, no birds, no ghosts/characters, NO text, NO captions, NO labels, NO UI, NO borders, no logos. Opaque full-bleed environment, no transparency.
